title: Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.32933v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. We present Yalda Embedding, a 595.8-million-parameter Persian retrieval model adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using more than one million query-document pairs. On eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB, the model achieves the highest macro-average among the evaluated 0.6B models, scoring 0.5488 and outperforming Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and F2LLM-v2-0.6B on every task. It also approaches Qwen3-Embedding-4B, winning on four tasks, tying on one, and trailing by 0.0075 in macro-average. An incremental ablation study examines contrastive batch size, optimization stabilization, and relational knowledge distillation from F2LLM-v2-8B. translated_title: Yalda-Embedding：一个具有竞争力的波斯语检索模型的开放开发
translated_abstract: 尽管多语言文本表示技术不断进步，但波斯语的有效密集检索仍然受到特定语言训练资源和紧凑嵌入模型可用性有限的制约。我们提出了Yalda Embedding，这是一个5.958亿参数的波斯语检索模型，基于Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B适配而来，使用了一百多万个查询-文档对进行训练。在FaMTEB的八个波斯语检索任务上，该模型在所评估的0.6B模型中取得了最高的宏平均值，得分0.5488，在每个任务上都优于Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B和F2LLM-v2-0.6B。它还接近Qwen3-Embedding-4B的性能，在四个任务上获胜，在一个任务上打平，宏平均值仅落后0.0075。一项增量消融研究考察了对比学习批量大小、优化稳定性以及从F2LLM-v2-8B进行的关系知识蒸馏。在单轮训练设置下，仅对比微调就能带来适度的平均改进……
tldr: 该论文提出Yalda Embedding，一个基于Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B适配、使用超百万查询-文档对训练的5.958亿参数波斯语检索模型，在FaMTEB的八个波斯语检索任务上超越所有同规模0.6B模型，并接近4B规模模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Yalda Embedding, a 595.8M-parameter Persian retrieval model adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using over one million query-document pairs, which achieves the best macro-average among evaluated 0.6B models on eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB and approaches the performance of the 4B-scale model.
